svg.title: One causal self-attention head
svg.desc: Seven tokens t₁ to t₇ each look up a 6-dimensional embedding, drawn as a strip of pixels. Three learned projections W_Q, W_K and W_V map every embedding to a 4-dimensional query, key and value. The queries sit beside the attention matrix and the keys stand above it as columns, so cell (i, j) holds softmax over keys of q_i·k_j/√d with d = 4. A causal mask removes every key that comes after its query, so the hatched upper triangle is zero and each row sums to one. One query row is highlighted; its weights a_i, turned on their side next to the values, set the strength of the lines that sum the values into the output vector z_i. The highlight sweeps down the rows one query at a time.
